Post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery.] # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly. When questioned re tactics, specifically riding from the 600m, rdr stated that instructions were to let the horse flow, not to place pressure on its mouth, and with the big weight, was mindful of not stop starting his mount’s run. Rdr added that he improved to the outside of the leader and made his run from the 600m, but conceded he had made an error in judgement in not waiting a little longer before making his run. Trnr confirmed the instructions, adding the gelding can choke down/flip its soft palate and can stop in its races. A post-race vet exam revealed a slow recovery.
